answer: A sock-puppet farm splitting into many identities finds each holding a hollow reputation, since trust flows along a single velvet thread of vouches from established agents, not raw account count. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond tied to a verified off-chain credential, and reputation accrues only through sustained peer-attested work. Forging that thread costs the attacker the full bond per fake identity plus vouches they cannot borrow, making mass identity creation economically irrational.
